name: PGNLZ
rootCause: According to BlockSec monitoring, an unknown contract on the BSC network was exploited. The attacker leveraged a design flaw in the “burn pair” mechanism to execute two reverse swaps, resulting in losses of approximately $100,000. The attacker first drained PGNLZ tokens, then triggered PGNLP burns and price manipulation, ultimately siphoning off most of the USDT from the liquidity pool.

descriptions.text: According to BlockSec monitoring, an unknown contract on the BSC network was exploited. The attacker leveraged a design flaw in the “burn pair” mechanism to execute two reverse swaps, resulting in losses of approximately $100,000. The attacker first drained PGNLZ tokens, then triggered PGNLP burns and price manipulation, ultimately siphoning off most of the USDT from the liquidity pool.

The PGNLZ token exploit on BNB Chain (Jan 27, 2026) allowed an attacker to use a flawed pool-burn mechanism to drain nearly all stablecoins from a PancakeSwap USDT,PGNLZ pool, causing losses around $100,000. The burn function could directly remove tokens from the pool without properly updating LP shares, enabling reserve manipulation and profit through price distortion. A faulty burn mechanism in the PGNLZ token allowed tokens to be burned directly from the liquidity pool's balance. This let an attacker reduce the PGNLZ reserve to near-zero, causing a severe imbalance and manipulated price, which was then used to drain the USDT side of the pool.
